featured_reviews.review_text:
It's been a while I wrote something about my favourite place .... Virar is my favourite place to dine. I have been trying to find new places to venture out my thirst for wonderful cuisines. My best friend took me to Durvaa, it was her favourite place to dine. Being a vegetarian, the options are limited within Virar. However, things just got upgraded. Durva, is an inviting place with amazing hospitality and great staff. I visited this place with my close friends as I had travelled from far. The ambience is absolutely amazing and inviting. The white and green art work looks surreal. I'm glad they gave importance to small details .

Food:- Being a Saturday, we wished to dine and venture out vegetarian food. My friend ordered the following dishes for us. Kichiya papad churo, Malai broccoli, Stuffed mushroom , Hot pot rice & Burnt Garlic rice. The food was absolutely amazing. We got our tables within 10 minutes as there was a rush being a Saturday. I took limited pictures as we were hungry to our core. We tried the kichiya papad chat, it was light roasted in ghee with spirinkled onions and chopped coriander. They were light and crunchy. I loved the stuffed mushrooms. They were a delight and my best dish of the day. The texture was silky smooth and tasty. The grill on it was simply perfect. Then, we tried the malai broccoli and it was simply amazing. I know it's very difficult to lot of people to eat broccoli but the marination on it was simply perfect. The grill was perfect and taste was luxury. We tried the Hot pot rice and it was full with luxury veggies. The taste of it was amazing and the soup offered was simply perfect. Mixed all the rice, veggies and gravy.. it was just textbook Chinese pot rice at any of the best places in Mumbai. We tried burnt garlic rice at the end. It was simple, fried garlic and a tinch of Schezwan. It was a rush and wonderful to eat at every bite. I loved all the dishes and they made my midnight lunch amazing .

Conclusion: It's been quite a while that I have experienced fine dining. The place, aura and even the out side seating was clean and hygienic. The food was perfect and balanced for any vegetarian. I'm glad that this place stood out of my expectations and my experience. I will visit this place soon on a weekday to enjoy more luxury mughlai and try that cottage cheese which I missed ordering. Thank you Nidhi for a wonderful treat and a great experience. Thumbs up!!! A great place to dine with family.

Disappointed, sorry!
Decending from 5 🌟 to 2 🌟

This used to be one of our favorite restaurants in Virar, known for its excellent food quality, service, ambiance, and overall facilities. We have visited multiple times for lunch, dinner, family gatherings, and parties, and have always enjoyed our experience here.

However, over the past few visits, we have noticed a gradual decline in the overall standards. The food quality and taste have deteriorated, despite a noticeable increase in menu prices. The service is no longer as prompt and attentive as it once was, which affects the overall dining experience.

The maintenance of the restaurant also seems to have suffered. During our recent visits, the air conditioning in the Blue Room was not functioning, and coolers were arranged as a temporary alternative. Cleanliness standards appear to have slipped, and the ambiance, including the lighting arrangements, is not maintained as well as before.

Another concern is the loud chatting among staff members at the bar station, which can be distracting and impacts the peaceful dining atmosphere that guests expect.

I would also like to offer a suggestion regarding the washroom layout in the Blue Room. The current arrangement feels awkward, as the gents' urinals are positioned at the entrance while the enclosed toilet, which may be used by ladies, is located further inside. For better privacy and convenience, the enclosed toilet should ideally be placed first, followed by a partition and then the gents' urinals.

Considering the restaurant's reputation and pricing, we expected a much better experience. I hope the management takes this feedback positively and works towards improving the food quality, service, maintenance, and overall guest experience to restore the standards that once made this restaurant a preferred dining destination.

Even in size they were tiny, with 2 bones without filled marrow which is the highlight of Rogan Josh. The quantity of pieces were not even enough for 1 adult. The mutton itself was properly cooked and tender. Overall it didn't justify the price. Rating: 6.5/10

5. Gassi Chicken also lacked something in taste. It felt as if it lacked aroma and spice flavour. The chicken pieces weren't marinated well and tasted bland to me. Rating: 6/10

6. Jawar Bhakri was very good. But I didn't order it with Ghee on it. It wasn't conveyed to us before serving and we only realised it when we were charged extra for ghee on it when I saw the bill. NOTE TO THE RESTAURANT: PLEASE DON'T  DO THIS! Rating: 8/10

7. Steam rice was well cooked with nice long grain rice. Rating: 10/10

8. Drinks were served nicely.

Overall I would highly rate this restaurant for its service. Highly for its starters. Medium for its main course. On a scale of 1 to 10, I would rate it a solid 8.5/10.
